title: BPW-2026-0556
text:
[BUREAU OF SANITATION]
BPW-2026-0556
CD ALL
REQUEST FOR AUTHORITY – CORDOBA CORPORATION
Recommending the Board:
AUTHORIZE the Director and General Manager of the Bureau of Sanitation or designee to issue Amendment No. 2 of Task Order Solicitation S-20 to Cordoba Corporation, including additional scope and additional staffing; and
APPROVE the budget increase by $4,842,747 to a total budget of $22,875,569. The term of engagement shall remain unchanged.
(W.O.: S041S20S, S10IS20O, SZC14163, SZC14164, SZC14165, S04IS20S, S33NCS13, C-145671)
summary: Authorizes Amendment No. 2 to Cordoba Corporation's Bureau of Sanitation task order, adding scope and staff, and raises its budget by $4,842,747 to $22,875,569 with the term unchanged.

details.action: task order amendment and budget increase

outcome.text: REPORT ADOPTED, SUBJECT TO CONDITIONS, FORTHWITH
